tools.name: search
tools.description: Search SuperhotGeo's curated records — the Superhot Well Registry, projects, field lessons, RockLab models and datasets, open engineering problems, and the research library. Use it first for any question about superhot rock geothermal, supercritical (>374 C) geothermal, enhanced/engineered geotherma

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one record returned by `search`, with its canonical URL and source.

tools.name: search_wells
tools.description: Search documented superhot and high-temperature geothermal wells worldwide (IDDP, Venelle-2, Kakkonda, Nesjavellir, The Geysers, Puna, Utah FORGE, Fervo, Mazama and more): max temperature, depth, lithology, what failed at temperature, root cause, lessons, induced seismicity, and a public source per

tools.name: ask_superhot
tools.description: Ask the SuperhotGeo Assistant any question about superhot rock / next-generation (supercritical, EGS) geothermal energy — the science, technology, projects, economics, policy, companies, or the SuperhotGeo platform. Returns a grounded answer with cited web sources. Requires a SuperhotGeo API key.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search SuperhotGeo's continuously curated library of superhot geothermal news, studies, journals, and resources.

tools.name: list_resource
tools.description: List records from a SuperhotGeo public collection. "trending" = the ranked front-page board of what the field is paying attention to right now (recomputed every 6h from recent saves/views + recency), each row carrying its rank, type, refId, and a one-line label; "projects" = superhot/next-gen geothe

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Fetch a single SuperhotGeo record by resource and id.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
